Name: BFAV Working Goose
Author: lamplight12347
Description:
[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]

Note: If updating please delete the old file/ files before installing because it will not override as the new folder has a different name.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OEDnhGz.png[/img]﻿

!! I did not create most of the files in this mod !!

All of the geese and egg sprites are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5888]BFAV Regular Goose[/url] I highly recommend you check out their mod!

!! This mod does not work with the animal husbandry mod, the original does however !!
(support for that mod will be added in the future)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KbbYjrK.png[/img]

Install the [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/updating-mods-for-stardew-valley-1-4.156000/page-46#post-3356278]Unoffical BFAV update
[/url]
Install [i]both [/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assests[/url]

Optional: Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url]

Then just install this mod!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Cc9mT9b.png[/img]

Adds a new animal, the elegant goose!
The goose comes in three varieties; white, wild and the ever elusive gold!!

The geese also lay eggs! Which unlike the original mod can be turned into mayonnaise.
The goose mayo is priced at 600g
(Currently there is no star quality goose mayo but this may be added in the future)

Downloads.Description: Extract this folder to Adopt 'n' Skin/assets/skins
